start: Homelander fires his lasers first. Omni-Man takes them on the chest and keeps flying straight at him.
turning_point: Up close it isn't a fight. Omni-Man is faster, hits harder and has ended entire armies. Homelander has never been hit by someone stronger, and it shows: he panics.
finish: Omni-Man grabs him mid-air and beats him into the ground until he stops moving.
underdog_path: Lasers straight into the eyes at point-blank range. The eyes are the one soft spot even a Viltrumite has.

start: Superman is faster off the mark and lands the first heavy punches. Thor shrugs them off; he has taken Hela's blades and Thanos' fists.
turning_point: Then Thor calls the storm. Lightning is pure energy that Superman can't out-punch, and Stormbreaker is a magic weapon, one of the few things that really cuts a Kryptonian.
finish: Thor charges Stormbreaker with lightning and throws it. It hits Superman square in the chest and he doesn't get up.
underdog_path: Speed and heat vision from far away. If Superman never lets Thor charge up a full blast, he can wear the god down.

start: Bakugo rockets in on explosions and hits the armor point-blank. The nanotech suit was built to take a punch from Thanos; it holds.
turning_point: Tony goes up and stays up. Bakugo has to get close to hurt anything, and FRIDAY keeps the suit just out of reach while missiles and repulsors rain down.
finish: A full-power unibeam knocks Bakugo out of the sky.
underdog_path: Bakugo's blasts grow with every round he lasts. If he gets under the suit and keeps hitting the same spot, the armor cracks.

start: Jean tries to rip Goku apart with telekinesis. His body moves before she finishes the thought and slips every grab.
turning_point: She goes for his mind next and finds nothing to grab: in Ultra Instinct Goku isn't thinking, his body just reacts.
finish: Goku closes the gap faster than she can focus the Phoenix Force and ends it with a Kamehameha at point-blank range.
underdog_path: Let the Phoenix take over completely. At full burn it can rebuild Jean from ashes as many times as it takes, and Goku tires before she does.

start: Spider-Man dodges everything. Spider-sense warns him about every punch, and the webs keep Yuji at a distance.
turning_point: But Yuji rips through webs like paper, and his punches carry cursed energy, a kind of damage Peter's body has no defense against.
finish: One clean Black Flash connects, and Spider-Man is done.
underdog_path: Never trade blows. If Spidey webs Yuji to a wall and keeps him there, brains beat brawn.

start: Vader reaches out with the Force. Magneto just lifts his hand.
turning_point: Vader's whole body is metal: the armor, the helmet, the machine that breathes for him. Magneto controls every piece of it.
finish: He crushes the breathing unit. Vader can't fight without air.
underdog_path: Force choke first. If Vader grabs Magneto's throat before the armor starts to bend, the Sith wins.

start: Diana is the better fighter and closes in fast, deflecting photon blasts with her bracelets.
turning_point: Carol goes Binary. She soaks up every hit as energy, flies faster than Diana can follow and starts shooting from range where the sword can't reach.
finish: A full-power photon blast from point-blank range.
underdog_path: The lasso. It's unbreakable: if Diana catches Carol and drags the fight to the ground, warrior skill beats raw power.

start: The Surfer is faster than light and fires Power Cosmic blasts that actually hurt.
turning_point: That's exactly what Vegeta wants. Ultra Ego turns every hit he takes into strength; the more the Surfer hurts him, the stronger he gets.
finish: Vegeta catches the board, pulls the Surfer in and finishes with a Final Flash.
underdog_path: Don't feed him. If the Surfer stops trading blows and just outruns Vegeta across space, there's nothing to absorb.

start: Two men who refuse to die. Wolverine's claws slice through Denji again and again.
turning_point: But every time Denji gets blood, he's back. His chainsaws can't cut adamantium bones, but they shred everything around them faster than Logan heals.
finish: Denji's Chainsaw Man form wakes up, and Logan's healing just can't keep pace.
underdog_path: Take his head off and keep him away from blood. Logan has a century of experience in ending fights fast.

start: With the Gauntlet, Thanos can do anything. The problem is time: every trick needs a thought, a gesture, a snap.
turning_point: Saitama moves faster than Thanos can raise his arm. The Space Stone throws him across the planet; he's back in a jump.
finish: Saitama gets there before the snap. One punch.
underdog_path: Snap first. If Thanos erases Saitama before he gets close, no punch fixes that.

start: Itachi opens with Tsukuyomi. Sukuna has lived a thousand years and shakes off the illusion in seconds.
turning_point: Susanoo blocks Dismantle for a while, but Sukuna opens his domain, and inside Malevolent Shrine every attack lands automatically.
finish: The Shrine cuts through Susanoo and everything inside it.
underdog_path: The Totsuka Sword seals whatever it stabs inside a dream forever. One hit and Sukuna is gone.

start: Black Adam opens with magic lightning. Naruto blocks with a Truth-Seeking Ball.
turning_point: A hundred clones swarm Adam from every side. He can blast ten at once, but the real Naruto is charging a Rasenshuriken behind them.
finish: The Rasenshuriken lands, and a Tailed Beast Bomb finishes him.
underdog_path: Black Adam is magic, and magic slips past chakra defenses. One clean bolt at full power can still drop Naruto.

start: Two monsters collide. Hulk lands the first big punches and Doomsday staggers.
turning_point: Then Doomsday adapts. Every hit makes him tougher, he absorbs energy, and his bone spikes start to cut through gamma skin.
finish: Doomsday wears Hulk down until even the rage can't get him up.
underdog_path: Hulk has no ceiling either. If the fight goes long enough and he gets angry enough, he can out-grow the adaptation.

start: Frieza is far faster and hits harder. But Doctor Manhattan saw this fight coming before it started.
turning_point: Manhattan doesn't need to be faster. He can take apart anything atom by atom with a thought, and Frieza's body is made of atoms.
finish: Manhattan disassembles Frieza mid-charge.
underdog_path: Speed. If Black Frieza lands a Death Ball before Manhattan reacts, even a god of physics gets blown apart.

start: Batman throws everything: smoke, batarangs, a grapple to the legs. Cap blocks it all with the shield.
turning_point: Batman's armor helps, but Steve can hold a helicopter in place with his arms. Every punch Cap lands goes right through the suit.
finish: Cap throws the shield, it bounces back, and he finishes Batman in close.
underdog_path: Prep time. Give Batman a day to plan and the fight starts with gas and traps Cap never sees coming.

start: Soldier Boy takes the first hits and keeps coming. He's a soldier first.
turning_point: All Might is faster and much stronger. Every Smash cracks the ground; a punch from him changes the weather.
finish: A United States of Smash lands before Soldier Boy can charge his chest blast.
underdog_path: His radiation blast can strip a supe's powers. If it works on One For All, All Might is just a sick man.

start: Natasha goes for the Widow's Bite. Levi is already behind her.
turning_point: Levi is an Ackerman: superhuman speed and strength, and twin blades that cut Titans. Natasha's batons can't block that.
finish: Two quick strikes and it's over.
underdog_path: Open ground, no buildings for the gear, and a gun. Natasha only needs one shot to land.

start: Strange opens with spells, shields and the Mirror Dimension. Wanda tears out of every trap.
turning_point: Chaos magic doesn't follow the rules Strange's spells depend on. She has already beaten a room full of the strongest sorcerers alive.
finish: Wanda bends reality around him, and the Sorcerer Supreme runs out of tricks.
underdog_path: Tricks and time. Strange won the Multiverse of Madness only by out-thinking her. If he traps her in a loop she can't feel, he wins.

start: Madara drops a meteor. Doom's force field holds.
turning_point: Doom has studied magic and technology for decades. He answers Susanoo with sorcery and keeps Doombots in reserve for every trick.
finish: Doom's magic finds the gap in Madara's chakra and seals it.
underdog_path: The Rinnegan absorbs energy attacks. If Madara eats Doom's magic blasts, the armor eventually runs dry.

start: Godzilla's tail slams down. Infinity stops it a hair from Gojo's head.
turning_point: Nothing Godzilla has can touch Gojo, and Hollow Purple erases whatever it hits. It carves a hole straight through the King of the Monsters.
finish: Godzilla regenerates, so Gojo hits him with Unlimited Void and then Purple again before he can recover.
underdog_path: Atomic breath at full power, again and again. If Gojo's cursed energy runs out first, Infinity goes down with it.

start: Jiren punches faster than sound. Galactus barely notices.
turning_point: The Power Cosmic can reshape matter itself. Jiren is the strongest mortal there is, but he is still made of matter.
finish: Galactus unmakes him with one gesture.
underdog_path: Speed and focus. If Jiren breaks through before Galactus gets serious, size won't matter.

start: Voldemort raises his wand. One green flash and the fight is over, if it lands.
turning_point: Star Platinum stops time before the curse leaves the wand. In stopped time, the Dark Lord is just a man standing still.
finish: Five frozen seconds is enough: the wand snaps, and Star Platinum does the rest.
underdog_path: Horcruxes. Voldemort comes back, and next time he Apparates behind Jotaro and casts before Star Platinum appears.

start: Tanjiro attacks with Water Breathing. The blade bounces off: vibranium doesn't cut.
turning_point: Worse, every slash charges the suit. The harder Tanjiro hits, the more energy T'Challa stores.
finish: T'Challa releases it all in one kinetic blast that throws Tanjiro across the field.
underdog_path: Tanjiro's nose finds weak spots. If Sun Breathing gets through a joint in the suit, the fight flips.

start: Hela fills the sky with blades and cuts Boros to ribbons.
turning_point: Boros regrows from every cut. And far from Asgard, Hela is weaker; her power comes from that one place.
finish: Collapsing Star Roaring Cannon: a blast big enough to wipe a planet's surface.
underdog_path: Fight in Asgard. There Hela's power has no limit, and she wins easily.

start: Darkseid fires Omega Beams. Sasuke swaps places with a rock and they miss.
turning_point: Darkseid is a brute, not a trickster. Sasuke's Rinnegan lets him teleport anywhere he can see, and his eyes burn with black flames that never go out.
finish: Amaterasu sets Darkseid on fire, and nothing puts it out.
underdog_path: Omega Beams bend around corners. If one gets past the Susanoo, even Sasuke goes down.

start: Loki fills the field with copies of himself. Each one talks, moves and casts like the real thing.
turning_point: The Sharingan sees through illusions. Kakashi ignores every fake and locks onto the real Loki in a second.
finish: Kamui warps the real Loki into another dimension. No exit, no audience to fool.
underdog_path: Shapeshifting. If Loki turns into one of Kakashi's friends, the Copy Ninja may hesitate for one fatal second.

start: Lex opens fire with the warsuit's cannons. Rengoku cuts through the blasts.
turning_point: Lex planned for flying, punching superhumans, not for a swordsman fast enough to slice a cannon in half.
finish: Ninth Form: Rengoku cuts through the suit's arm and chest plate.
underdog_path: Prep time. Give Lex a week and a scan of Rengoku's moves, and the suit will counter every form.

start: Sentry overpowers him early. A million exploding suns is a lot to take.
turning_point: Garou learns from every hit. Within minutes he copies Sentry's flight and power and starts countering.
finish: In Cosmic Fear mode, Garou finishes it with a Gamma Ray Burst.
underdog_path: The Void. If Sentry's dark side takes over, nothing Garou has learned can hold it back.

start: Aizen thinks he has the fight under control. Flash is already standing behind him.
turning_point: Kyoka Suigetsu only works if you see the sword. At light speed, Flash never looks.
finish: An infinite-mass punch knocks Aizen out before he knows the fight started.
underdog_path: Aizen's hypnosis is total. If Flash glimpses the sword even once, every move he makes is wrong.

start: Aquaman calls whales and sharks. Kaido turns into a dragon and burns them all.
turning_point: On land and in the air, Kaido is simply stronger. Arthur needs water, and Kaido never lets the fight touch the sea.
finish: Thunder Bagua: Kaido's club smashes Aquaman into the rocks.
underdog_path: Devil Fruit users can't swim. If Aquaman drags Kaido underwater even once, he loses all his strength and drowns.

start: Invincible flies in and lands heavy hits. Luffy's rubber body bounces them right off.
turning_point: Gear 5 turns the fight into a cartoon: Luffy grabs lightning, inflates his fists and makes the ground rubber. And his Haki hits through Viltrumite toughness.
finish: A giant Bajrang Gun drives Mark into the ground.
underdog_path: Gear 5 burns out fast. If Mark survives until it does, he's still flying and Luffy isn't.

start: Starlight opens with a blinding flash. For a moment Muzan freezes; light is the one thing he fears.
turning_point: Then he realizes it doesn't burn. Her light is electricity, not sunlight, and he regrows from the blast in seconds.
finish: His whip-like limbs lash out faster than she can recharge.
underdog_path: If her light counts as sunlight, Muzan turns to ash in one shot.

start: Cyborg goes for his favorite move, hacking. Deku has no tech to hack.
turning_point: Danger Sense warns Deku before every sonic cannon shot, and Blackwhip yanks Cyborg off his feet.
finish: A 100% Smash crumples the armor.
underdog_path: Stay at range and teleport with boom tubes until Deku runs out of stamina.

start: Battle Beast charges with his axe. He's waited a long time for a fight like this.
turning_point: Zoro's blades are coated in Haki, which cuts through hide that shrugs off bullets and fists.
finish: Asura: nine swords' worth of slashes at once.
underdog_path: Battle Beast heals fast and never gets tired. If the fight goes long, the cuts won't be enough.

start: Eren transforms. Storm is already in the sky, out of reach.
turning_point: The Titan regrows from every burn, but its weak spot never moves: the nape, where Eren sits. Lightning goes exactly where Storm sends it.
finish: A bolt straight into the nape the moment hardening cracks.
underdog_path: The Founding Titan and the Rumbling. Millions of Colossal Titans are too many for one storm to stop.

start: Shazam calls down his lightning. Jean catches the bolt with her mind and throws it back.
turning_point: Under the muscles, Shazam is a teenage boy, and Jean is the strongest telepath alive. She walks straight into his head.
finish: Billy forgets the magic word. Without it, he's just a kid in a cape.
underdog_path: Magic. Shazam's powers come from gods, not science, and one point-blank bolt before she gets in his head could drop her.

start: Yoda sees the first slashes coming and flips away from every one.
turning_point: Then Sukuna opens his domain. Inside Malevolent Shrine every cut lands automatically. Foresight is useless when there's nowhere to dodge.
finish: The Shrine shreds everything within reach, the little Jedi Master included.
underdog_path: Yoda can push Sukuna out of the domain's range with the Force before it closes. Outside it, he's quick enough to win.

start: Deadpool opens fire with both pistols. Killua is already behind him.
turning_point: Godspeed makes Killua faster than bullets, and his lightning locks Deadpool's muscles in place. Healing doesn't help if you can't move.
finish: Killua shocks him again and again until Wade stays down.
underdog_path: Deadpool can't die. Every time Killua relaxes, Wade gets up, and eventually the kid runs out of aura.

start: They trade blows at full speed. Superman is slightly stronger in a fist fight.
turning_point: But Black Adam's lightning is magic, and magic is one of the few things that really hurts a Kryptonian.
finish: A point-blank bolt of the Rock of Eternity's lightning puts Superman in the ground.
underdog_path: Heat vision from range. If Superman never lets Adam get close enough to strike, he wins on endurance.

start: Diana charges with the sword. It stops a hair from Gojo's face: Infinity doesn't let anything touch him.
turning_point: She's far stronger, but that doesn't matter. Her lasso, sword and fists are all physical, and Infinity stops all of it.
finish: Hollow Purple erases everything in its path. Diana's bracelets can't block what deletes them.
underdog_path: The god-killer sword is a divine weapon. If it can cut through Infinity the way Sukuna's slash did, Gojo dies in one swing.

start: Homelander lasers the first shadows. They just get back up: they're already dead.
turning_point: Jinwoo sends hundreds of shadow soldiers while he vanishes in Stealth. Homelander can't laser what he can't find.
finish: Jinwoo appears behind him and his daggers find the throat.
underdog_path: Fly straight up and keep going. Homelander is faster than most of the army, and the shadows can't follow forever.

start: Natasha is quicker and lands three clean hits. Maeve barely notices.
turning_point: Widow's Bite stings, but Maeve fought Homelander. Batons and kicks won't put a supe down.
finish: Maeve catches a kick and throws Natasha through a wall.
underdog_path: Natasha is a spy. If the fight starts with a sniper rifle or a trap instead of a fistfight, she wins.

start: Netero's giant Guanyin comes down a thousand times a second. Hulk takes all of it.
turning_point: Every hit makes Hulk angrier, and angrier means stronger. Netero is 120 years old and his aura runs out.
finish: Hulk grabs the Guanyin's arm and smashes it apart, then Netero with it.
underdog_path: The Poor Man's Rose. Netero's last move is a bomb in his own heart, and it could take even Hulk down.

start: John fires first, two shots to the chest. Voldemort turns the bullets to dust in the air.
turning_point: Voldemort Apparates around the room. John is the best killer alive, but he can't hit a man who teleports.
finish: One green flash. There's no armor against the Killing Curse.
underdog_path: A headshot from the dark before Voldemort knows he's there. John doesn't miss.

start: Butcher takes Temp V and opens with laser eyes. Batman's armor catches the beam.
turning_point: Batman has fought aliens and gods. A man with one day of borrowed powers is a problem he's already planned for.
finish: Smoke, a grapple and a gas pellet. Butcher wakes up in a cell.
underdog_path: Temp V makes Butcher super strong. One clean punch could still go through the armor.

start: Lex opens fire with the warsuit's cannons. Vader deflects them with his lightsaber.
turning_point: The armor protects Lex from outside, but the Force reaches inside. Vader closes his fist.
finish: Lex suffocates inside his own suit.
underdog_path: Speed and range. If Lex flies high and fires before Vader can focus, the Force has nothing to grab.

start: Denji charges with the chainsaws revving. All Might is already in front of him.
turning_point: One Detroit Smash and there's nothing left of Denji. He drinks blood and comes back, and gets punched again.
finish: All Might's punches hit faster than Denji can revive. Eventually there's no blood left nearby.
underdog_path: Chainsaw Man's true form. When Pochita takes over, it can erase what it eats, and that changes everything.

start: Thor opens with lightning and a Stormbreaker throw. Gohan takes the hit and keeps flying.
turning_point: Beast Gohan is on another level. Thor hits hard, but Gohan beat Cell Max, a monster far stronger than any storm.
finish: Special Beam Cannon at point-blank range.
underdog_path: Gohan holds back until he's angry. If Thor finishes it fast, before Beast form wakes up, he wins.

start: Bakugo blasts straight in, explosions popping off a magnetic force field.
turning_point: His grenade gauntlets are metal. Magneto rips them off his arms and throws Bakugo across the field with them.
finish: Magneto drops a steel beam frame around him and squeezes.
underdog_path: Explosions come from Bakugo's own sweat, not his gear. If he gets past the force field, Magneto is just an old man.

start: Doomsday crushes the first Susanoo and adapts to it. Every hit makes him tougher.
turning_point: Madara stops trying to damage him. You can't adapt to being trapped.
finish: Chibaku Tensei: Madara pulls the ground into a sphere around Doomsday and launches it into the sky.
underdog_path: Raw strength. If Doomsday breaks out of the sphere, he comes back immune to it.

start: Daredevil hears DIO's heartbeat and moves first. For a second it looks good.
turning_point: Then DIO stops time. Radar sense means nothing when the world is frozen.
finish: Nine seconds of stopped time and a row of knives in the air.
underdog_path: Daylight. DIO is a vampire, and the sun ends him instantly. Daredevil just has to drag the fight outside.

start: Mob hits Susanoo with enough psychic force to flatten a building. It holds.
turning_point: Sasuke swaps places with debris, burns Mob's barriers with black flames and stays a step ahead.
finish: A Chidori through the last barrier.
underdog_path: ???%. If Mob's emotions explode, his power has no clear ceiling.

start: Strange pulls Frieza into the Mirror Dimension and folds the world around him.
turning_point: Frieza doesn't care. He breaks out of the dimension like a door and keeps coming. Strange's spells are fast, but Frieza is faster.
finish: A Death Beam through the shield before Strange finishes the next spell.
underdog_path: Banishment. If Strange opens a portal to the Dark Dimension under Frieza, he never comes back.

start: Gear 5 Luffy grabs at Carol with giant rubber hands. She's already a hundred meters up.
turning_point: Carol fires photon blasts from the sky. Rubber shrugs off punches, but this is pure energy, and it burns.
finish: A Binary blast at full power, and Luffy's Gear 5 times out.
underdog_path: Haki. If Luffy lands one Conqueror's Haki-coated punch, it hits through anything, Binary included.

start: Cyborg's sensors scan the room. They find six Lokis.
turning_point: Illusions are magic, not light, and the sensors can't tell which one is real. Cyborg wastes sonic blasts on ghosts.
finish: The real Loki slips a dagger into a gap in the armor from behind.
underdog_path: Mother Box tech. If Cyborg locks onto Loki's energy signature instead of his image, the trick stops working.

start: Joker pulls a gun and empties it. The bullets just bounce off the suit.
turning_point: T'Challa has heart-shaped herb strength and claws. Joker has a joy buzzer and a bad joke.
finish: One punch and the Clown Prince is out cold.
underdog_path: Joker never fights fair. A hostage or a bomb in the room, and T'Challa has to choose.

start: Hal builds a giant green wall. Hela's blades punch straight through it.
turning_point: Even far from Asgard, Hela is a goddess. Hal's constructs are as strong as his will, and she breaks them faster than he builds them.
finish: A blade through the ring hand.
underdog_path: Range and flight. Hal can stay in the sky and pound her from afar until she tires.

start: Doom raises a force field and starts a spell. Flash has already circled him a hundred times.
turning_point: Doom plans for everything, but Flash moves faster than plans can change. He phases through the field.
finish: A thousand punches in a second, and the armor caves in.
underdog_path: Doom has had decades to prepare. A trap built for a speedster, set before Flash arrives, ends it instantly.

start: Thragg flies at him faster than sound. Kakashi barely gets out of the way.
turning_point: Kamui can warp part of Thragg's body into another dimension, but it needs a moment of focus, and Thragg never gives him one.
finish: A punch Kakashi doesn't see coming.
underdog_path: One clean Kamui. If Kakashi gets a second of focus, Thragg loses an arm, or his head.

start: Ultra Instinct dodges every attack. But Manhattan isn't throwing attacks.
turning_point: He sees past, present and future at once, and he can take apart anything atom by atom. Goku's body is made of atoms.
finish: Manhattan disassembles Goku in the middle of a Kamehameha.
underdog_path: Ultra Instinct reacts faster than thought. If Goku lands one hit before Manhattan acts, even a god of physics can be destroyed.

start: Meruem attacks with his tail. Shanks sees it a second before it moves.
turning_point: Meruem learns any fighting style in minutes, but Shanks' Haki isn't a style. His Conqueror's Haki crushes the will of anything weaker.
finish: Divine Departure, a Haki-coated slash straight through the Ant King.
underdog_path: Meruem absorbs the power of what he eats. If he survives long enough to learn Haki, he becomes unstoppable.

start: Starlight blinds Yuji with a flash. He keeps coming with his eyes closed.
turning_point: Yuji survived fights that tore his body apart. A light blast hurts, but it won't stop him.
finish: One Divergent Fist and Starlight is down.
underdog_path: Drain a city's power grid and fire it all at once. Starlight's biggest blasts can knock down a supe.

start: Wolverine charges with his claws out. Star Platinum is faster than any human.
turning_point: Logan heals from every punch, but Jotaro can stop time and hit him a hundred times in a second.
finish: Enough punches in stopped time to knock out even a man with an adamantium skull.
underdog_path: Logan never stays down. If Jotaro can't knock him out, Wolverine gets close enough to cut, and Jotaro doesn't heal.

start: Boros blasts Ghost Rider to pieces. The skull reforms; Hellfire doesn't die easily.
turning_point: Boros has wiped out entire planets. Penance Stare makes him feel every one of those deaths at once, and regeneration doesn't heal a soul.
finish: Boros collapses, screaming, under the weight of his own crimes.
underdog_path: Collapsing Star Roaring Cannon before Ghost Rider locks eyes. Nothing reforms from that.

start: Thanos throws a Power Stone blast. Garou copies the angle and comes back faster.
turning_point: The Gauntlet can do anything, but every trick takes a moment. Cosmic Garou moves faster than Thanos can think.
finish: Garou reaches him before the snap and rips the Gauntlet off his hand.
underdog_path: Snap first. If Thanos erases Garou before he closes the distance, speed doesn't matter.

start: Storm rises into the sky. Tanjiro's sword can't reach her up there.
turning_point: She calls lightning down on a boy with a blade. He's fast, but not faster than lightning.
finish: A bolt straight down.
underdog_path: Tanjiro can smell her next move. If he catches her low to the ground, one slash is enough.

start: Deku hits a 100% Smash. Aquaman's body is built to take the pressure of the deep ocean; he shrugs it off.
turning_point: Arthur is stronger and much tougher. His trident breaks Blackwhip, and Deku's arms take damage from his own punches.
finish: The trident's blunt end drives Deku into the ground.
underdog_path: Float and Danger Sense. If Deku keeps out of reach and hits from range, he can wear Arthur down.

start: Itachi's Sharingan meets Tony's eyes, through a screen. The illusion needs real eye contact; inside the helmet, it doesn't land.
turning_point: Tony fires missiles from range while FRIDAY maps every move. Susanoo blocks them, but Itachi is getting tired.
finish: A unibeam cracks Susanoo, and Itachi has nothing left.
underdog_path: Amaterasu. Black flames on the armor never go out, and Tony can't take off the suit fast enough.

start: J'onn phases through Godzilla's tail and reaches into his mind. There's too much monster to control.
turning_point: Then the spines light up blue. Atomic breath is pure heat, and fire is the one thing a Martian can't stand.
finish: One burst of atomic breath and J'onn goes down.
underdog_path: Phasing and shapeshifting. If J'onn stays intangible and strikes from inside, Godzilla can't hit what isn't there.

start: Eve turns the ground under Battle Beast into sand. He jumps out and keeps charging.
turning_point: She can rebuild matter, but she needs a moment of focus, and Battle Beast never stops attacking.
finish: One swing of the axe breaks her shield.
underdog_path: Eve could turn his axe into flowers, or the air around him into a cage. If she gets two seconds of calm, she wins.

start: Hulk lands a massive punch. Cell's head comes off. He grows a new one.
turning_point: Perfect Cell is far faster and can blow up a solar system. Hulk is strong, but this is a different scale.
finish: A full-power Kamehameha.
underdog_path: Rage with no ceiling. If the fight goes long enough, Hulk might just keep growing.

start: Daredevil hears the wand move and dodges the first curse.
turning_point: Voldemort Apparates behind him. Radar sense warns him, but not fast enough twice.
finish: The second Killing Curse doesn't miss.
underdog_path: Close the distance. Daredevil is deadly in melee; if he grabs the wand hand, the curse never comes.

start: Doomsday adapts to everything that hurts him. Sentry just keeps hitting harder.
turning_point: A million exploding suns is a lot to adapt to at once. Sentry flies Doomsday into orbit.
finish: He tears Doomsday apart the way he tore Ares in half.
underdog_path: Doomsday comes back from death immune. If one piece survives, round two goes the other way.

start: Darkseid fires the Omega Effect. Thor catches it on Stormbreaker.
turning_point: Thor has killed Thanos and fought Hela. Darkseid is huge, but he's slow, and Thor hits from the sky.
finish: Stormbreaker through the chest, with all the lightning Thor can call.
underdog_path: Omega beams bend around corners. One clean hit to Thor's head could end it.

start: Loki fills the room with copies. Homelander's X-ray vision picks the real one in a second.
turning_point: Loki's daggers bounce off Homelander's skin. Illusions buy time, but nothing in his bag can hurt the man.
finish: Homelander grabs the real Loki and drops him from the stratosphere.
underdog_path: Shapeshifting and lies. Loki can't win the fight, but he can trick Homelander into a fight with someone who can.

start: Hal crushes Buu with a giant green hammer. Buu reforms in a second.
turning_point: Kid Buu regrows from any scrap. Hal's constructs can't kill what can't be broken.
finish: Buu blows up the planet, and Hal with it.
underdog_path: Seal him away. A green construct prison launched into the sun might hold even Buu.

start: Invincible flies at Madara and smashes into Susanoo. It holds.
turning_point: Madara can block, absorb and drop meteors from the sky. Mark is fast, but he has never fought someone this tricky.
finish: A meteor drop with Mark pinned underneath.
underdog_path: Speed. Mark flies faster than sound, and if he gets inside Susanoo, Madara is just a man.

start: Joker pulls a knife. Natasha disarms him in a second.
turning_point: She's a trained spy and killer. He's a clown with gadgets and no fighting skill.
finish: A Widow's Bite to the chest, and Joker is down laughing.
underdog_path: Joker never plays fair. Gas, a hidden gun or a bomb: he only needs one trick to work.

start: Naruto floods the field with clones. The Surfer blasts them all from orbit.
turning_point: The Power Cosmic can rearrange matter. Naruto's clones and chakra can't touch a man flying faster than light.
finish: A cosmic blast at point-blank range.
underdog_path: Sage sensing and Six Paths sealing. If Naruto catches the Surfer once, he can seal him.

start: Butcher takes Temp V and fires laser eyes. Cap's vibranium shield catches the beam.
turning_point: Butcher has borrowed powers for a day. Cap has decades of training and the best shield on Earth.
finish: The shield hits Butcher square in the face, and Cap finishes it.
underdog_path: Temp V makes Butcher stronger than Cap. If he wins the first exchange, the fight's over.

start: T'Challa charges with claws out. Vader raises a hand.
turning_point: The vibranium suit protects from hits, not the Force. Vader lifts him off the ground by the throat.
finish: The Force choke does the rest.
underdog_path: Kinetic release. If T'Challa gets close and unloads the suit's stored energy, Vader goes flying.

start: Batman throws batarangs. Muzan regrows from every cut.
turning_point: Muzan has hunted humans for a thousand years. His whip limbs move faster than any human can dodge.
finish: One whip strike through the armor.
underdog_path: Prep time. Batman would bring UV grenades: sunlight in a can is the one thing Muzan fears.

start: Saitama punches. Vegeta takes it and smiles.
turning_point: Ultra Ego turns every hit into strength. The harder Saitama punches, the stronger Vegeta gets.
finish: Vegeta answers with a Final Flash that finally makes Saitama take a fight seriously, too late.
underdog_path: Serious Series. If Saitama's Serious Punch lands, Ultra Ego might not have time to grow.

start: Omni-Man flies in faster than sound. Kakashi dodges the first strike with the Sharingan.
turning_point: Kamui could warp part of Omni-Man into another dimension, but it takes focus, and Omni-Man never stops attacking.
finish: One punch that Kakashi doesn't see coming.
underdog_path: One clean Kamui. If Kakashi gets a moment of focus, Omni-Man loses an arm, or his head.

start: Thragg flies at him. Sasuke swaps places with a rock.
turning_point: Thragg is pure brute force. Sasuke teleports anywhere he can see, and his eyes set fire to anything he looks at.
finish: Amaterasu sets Thragg on fire, and nothing puts black flames out.
underdog_path: Speed. Thragg is faster than anything Sasuke has fought; one hit before the swap ends it.

start: Tanjiro charges. Itachi's Sharingan meets his eyes.
turning_point: Tsukuyomi traps Tanjiro in an illusion that lasts days in a split second.
finish: When Tanjiro wakes up, the fight is already over.
underdog_path: Tanjiro's sense of smell isn't fooled by illusions. If he never looks Itachi in the eye, one slash can win.

start: Wolverine charges with claws out. Yoda lifts him off the ground with the Force.
turning_point: Healing doesn't help when you can't reach the enemy. Yoda tosses him around like a rag doll.
finish: A lightsaber through the arm, and Logan stays down.
underdog_path: Logan's healing factor never quits. If he survives long enough to get close, he's deadly.

start: Yuji jumps at Storm. She's already in the sky.
turning_point: Yuji is tough, but he can't fly, and Storm can throw lightning all day.
finish: A bolt straight down.
underdog_path: Yuji can throw anything. A car through the storm, and Storm falls.

start: Superman is far stronger and faster. Sukuna has never fought anything like him.
turning_point: But Sukuna's World-Cutting Slash cuts space itself, and durability doesn't matter when space is cut. Superman has to stay out of range.
finish: Heat vision from a distance, too fast for Sukuna to set up the slash.
underdog_path: The slash that cut Gojo through Infinity. If it lands, Superman is cut in half.

start: Kaido crushes Ghost Rider with his club. The skull reforms.
turning_point: Kaido has conquered nations and killed thousands. Penance Stare makes him feel every one of those deaths at once.
finish: The strongest creature alive breaks under the weight of his own crimes.
underdog_path: Burn Ghost Rider with dragon fire before he locks eyes. Hellfire versus dragon fire, and Kaido is tougher.

start: Hela fills the sky with blades. Beast Gohan dodges all of them.
turning_point: Hela is a goddess, but Gohan is faster and much stronger.
finish: Special Beam Cannon through the chest.
underdog_path: Fight in Asgard. There, Hela's power has no limit.

start: Thanos raises the Gauntlet. Flash has already taken it off his hand.
turning_point: Every trick of the Gauntlet takes a moment. Flash moves faster than light; Thanos thinks at normal speed.
finish: Flash runs around Thanos a thousand times and drops him with an infinite-mass punch.
underdog_path: Snap first. If Thanos snaps before Flash moves, speed can't fix being erased.

start: Godzilla roars and fires atomic breath. Shanks dodges it with future sight.
turning_point: Godzilla is huge and regenerates, but Shanks' Haki-coated blade cuts through anything.
finish: Divine Departure cuts Godzilla open from neck to tail.
underdog_path: Godzilla regenerates. If the fight goes long, Shanks gets tired before Godzilla does.

start: Cyborg fires his sonic cannon. Soldier Boy takes it on the shield.
turning_point: Cyborg is mostly machine, and Soldier Boy's chest blast is a nuclear burst. Electronics don't like radiation.
finish: One blast fries Cyborg's systems.
underdog_path: Hacking. If Cyborg cuts power to the city around Soldier Boy and boom-tubes away, he wins the long game.

start: Levi cuts Venom to ribbons. The symbiote reforms.
turning_point: Blades don't kill symbiotes. Levi is fast, but Venom keeps getting up.
finish: Venom grabs Levi mid-swing and crushes him.
underdog_path: Sound and fire hurt a symbiote. If Levi drags the fight to a loud, burning place, Venom weakens.

start: Ichigo fires a Getsuga Tensho. Manhattan watches it pass through him.
turning_point: Manhattan sees the future and controls matter. Ichigo's swords and energy are just atoms to him.
finish: Manhattan disassembles Ichigo mid-swing.
underdog_path: Ichigo's spiritual power isn't matter. If it hits something Manhattan can't control, he could get hurt.

start: Black Adam calls his lightning. Jean catches it with her mind.
turning_point: She reaches into his head. He's a 5,000-year-old warrior, but she's the strongest telepath alive.
finish: She makes him forget why he's fighting.
underdog_path: Magic. Black Adam's power comes from gods, and one bolt before Jean focuses might break her concentration.

start: John fires first. Rengoku cuts the bullets in half.
turning_point: Rengoku is faster than any gunman, and his sword cuts through anything.
finish: Ninth Form: Rengoku.
underdog_path: Headshot. John doesn't miss, and one bullet is enough for any human.

start: All Might is far faster up close, and the first punch dents the armor.
turning_point: Tony goes up and stays up. All Might can't fly, and the missiles keep coming.
finish: A unibeam from orbit.
underdog_path: All Might's punches change the weather. One lucky hit and the armor's gone.

start: Zoro swings. The blade passes right through J'onn.
turning_point: J'onn phases and reads every move before Zoro makes it. Haki can hit spirits, but not a man who isn't there.
finish: J'onn goes solid inside Zoro's guard and knocks him out.
underdog_path: Haki hits spirits and illusions. If Zoro coats his blades just right, phasing stops working.

start: Eren transforms. Battle Beast is delighted: a giant opponent.
turning_point: The Titan regrows from every cut, but Battle Beast knows where to aim: the nape, where Eren sits.
finish: One axe swing straight through the nape.
underdog_path: The Rumbling. Millions of Colossal Titans are too many for one warrior.

start: Shazam throws lightning. Strange shields it and opens a portal behind him.
turning_point: Strange knows magic far better than a kid who got his powers yesterday.
finish: A Mirror Dimension trap, and Shazam is stuck.
underdog_path: Shazam's lightning is magic too, and stronger than Strange's shields. One full bolt might break through.

start: Frieza flies at Galactus at full speed. Galactus raises a hand.
turning_point: The Power Cosmic can rearrange matter. Frieza is fast and strong, but he's made of matter like everything else.
finish: Galactus unmakes him with a gesture.
underdog_path: Speed. If Frieza breaks through before Galactus gets serious, size won't matter.

start: Two men who refuse to die. Deadpool cuts Denji in half; Denji drinks blood and comes back.
turning_point: Deadpool heals, but chainsaws do more damage than katanas, and Denji keeps chewing.
finish: Chainsaw Man's true form wakes up, and Deadpool's healing can't keep up.
underdog_path: Deadpool can't die. If the fight goes long enough, Denji runs out of blood first.

start: Eve turns the floor under DIO into a cage. He's already gone.
turning_point: DIO stops time for nine seconds. Eve can rebuild matter, but not in a world that's frozen.
finish: A knife through her shield in stopped time.
underdog_path: Eve could turn DIO's body into something that isn't a vampire. If she gets one second of focus, he's gone.
